$comment: A latte .bx file is a markup document, not Beans with tags in it. Its comment is <!-- -->, not //: a // in markup is two ordinary characters that reach the page, and Toggle Comment writing one would delete nothing and add text to the output. The Beans inside <beans> keeps its own comments through the grammar's embedded scopes.
$wordPatternComment: An attribute name may carry - . and :, so on:click, bind:value.int and data-count are one word each; the leading $ is optional so $if and $self.count are too.
$indentComment: Indent after an open tag that is not self-closing, after a $ block's header brace, and after any of the bracket pairs. Outdent on a closing tag, a bare } (which at markup level closes a block) and the other closers.

onEnterRules.$comment: Enter between an open and a close tag indents and puts the close tag on its own line.
Enter between a $ block's braces does the same. The header is copied through as Beans and may hold anything, so the rule asks only for the brace that ends it.
